scope_definition.definition_of_done: Package-specific acceptance and evidence reviewed at the applicable stage. A useful internal slice does not close outstanding pilot, production or value gates.

implementation_outline.contracts: Bind source, schema, config, provider/country versions and environment to every release artifact
services: Integrate complete workflow chain, access matrix, failure drills, migrations/restore and scoped performance checks
Reconcile overlapping modernization program evidence; resolve current failures rather than inheriting old pass/fail claims
implementation_outline.data: Consolidated migration rehearsal and recovery manifest; data/queue count and monetary tie-out. No irreversible switch until recovery evidence; preserve all prior artifacts.
implementation_outline.security: Use existing tenant/role/location/module authority; enforce current source ownership, least privilege and stage-appropriate consent.
implementation_outline.ui: Reuse existing surfaces and design primitives after the source-owned contract; implement the scoped success/failure/denied/stale states.
integrations_and_operations: Dated source/version decision, employer applicability, expected calculations and accepted evidence channels
One supported statement specification and representative signed/sanitized samples; sandbox/contract evidence before live rail
Verified channel, worker, consent, unknown/retry/delivery receipt and suppression drill
Isolated database, authenticated roles, fake/sandbox providers, restore target, phone/network matrix; no production credentials assumed
Recheck current candidate; September 5 modernization report says Windows standalone packaging failed despite compilation; resolve actual remaining failure

data_implications.plan: Consolidated migration rehearsal and recovery manifest; data/queue count and monetary tie-out. No irreversible switch until recovery evidence; preserve all prior artifacts.
data_implications.schema_decision: Inspect existing schema before proposing an additive change; do not pre-authorize a migration. Required changes, if any, need a reconciled rehearsal in the isolated target.
data_implications.retention_and_compatibility: Preserve authoritative originals and prior versions, old deep links/exports where applicable, and documented retention. Never infer that name removal alone anonymizes sensitive data.
data_implications.backfill: No silent historical fact synthesis; dry-run manifest and source count/amount reconciliation for any justified backfill.
data_implications.recovery: Disable new entry/dispatch or derived feature; preserve authoritative records. Use existing reversal/correction/replay services for accepted work.

acceptance_criteria.behavior: All package validation and applicable production gates have current evidence, reviewer and version
Cross-workflow interruption, duplicate/concurrent request, stale evidence, tenant isolation and corrections satisfy controls
No critical unresolved defect, missing country approval or unproven provider action is waived by date or aggregate test count

verification.command_status: DISCOVERED_FOR_REUSE; only suites in the fresh planning receipt were run in this task
missing_checks: Current-candidate scoped integration/database/browser/accessibility/load/restore and release packaging results
Independent controls review and per-lane production entry decision
verification.environment: Mocked local tests first; isolated PostgreSQL and authenticated role fixtures for integration; sandbox provider only where applicable; agreed phone/EN-FR matrix for UI.
verification.production_boundary: No past source/mock pass certifies deployment; bind fresh required checks to the actual candidate.

estimate.waiting_rule: External intake can overlap engineering; estimates are assumptions, not committed provider/reviewer lead times.
estimate.counting_rule: Engineering includes implementation and developer tests. Specialist days are separate. Shared foundations are charged only in their owning package; do not add feature headline estimates from the audit.

rollout.internal_entry: Source baseline and hard prerequisite contracts available; external discovery can start before approval. Use synthetic records until environment/consent gates permit otherwise.
rollout.internal_exit: Package acceptance cases pass with current source binding and independent applicable review.
rollout.pilot_entry: Applicable G01–G10 criteria with named consenting cohort, actual support and rollback owner; no global release required for a safe separable lane.
rollout.production_entry: G11 and all applicable domain gates; expert/provider evidence is required for exact claims. Parent program stays incomplete while a required lane is blocked.
monitoring: All scoped production-entry gates evidenced with accountable operating owners
Escaped critical defect; stale artifact; unresolved workflow
authorization/privacy denials, stale evidence, duplicate effects and support cost
rollout.rollback_trigger: Hold only affected lanes when separable; full program remains incomplete while a required lane is blocked.
rollout.fallback: Consolidated migration rehearsal and recovery manifest; data/queue count and monetary tie-out. No irreversible switch until recovery evidence; preserve all prior artifacts.

measurement.countermetric: Escaped critical defect; stale artifact; unresolved workflow
measurement.baseline: Capture comparable eligible tasks before intervention, define denominator/window/role, exclude staff and tests; retain unassisted versus supported cohorts. Unknown baseline is not zero.
measurement.reconsideration: Hold only affected lanes when separable; full program remains incomplete while a required lane is blocked.
